subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: What canonical progress contract should the Control UI consume for active run phase, waiting state, latest action, elapsed time, and reconnect recovery?
rationale: The remaining work defines public gateway/session semantics and user-facing UI taxonomy, and the open PR candidates do not yet settle the API, persistence, or UX contract.

options.title: Approve gateway-backed activity contract
options.body: Define the sessions activity/attention RPC or event model first, then have the Control UI render the compact progress strip from that source of truth.

options.title: Narrow to UI-only status
options.body: Permit a smaller Control UI strip built from existing hasActiveRun, session.tool, and chat lifecycle signals while accepting weaker subagent and reconnect semantics.

options.title: Defer behind canonical issue
options.body: Keep this issue open but block implementation until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 lands or is explicitly narrowed.

recommendation.title: Approve gateway-backed activity contract
recommendation.body: Define the sessions activity/attention RPC or event model first, then have the Control UI render the compact progress strip from that source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the canonical gateway activity issue that this Control UI surface should consume or align with.
